headline: Obaidul Quader ordered attacks on students via phone call
summary: Call records between Quader and Saddam are now before the tribunal, revealing instructions to target students.
details: A call record has emerged showing that Obaidul Quader ordered Saddam to attack students over the phone.
The recording, which captures the instructions to target students, has been submitted to the tribunal as evidence.
This development comes as part of ongoing legal proceedings regarding attacks on students during recent unrest.
The tribunal is now reviewing the call logs and audio recordings to determine the extent of the coordination between the two individuals.

headline_marked: Ishrak Hossain claims [[interim govt embezzled funds]] for July martyrs' graves
headline: Ishrak Hossain claims interim govt embezzled funds for July martyrs' graves
summary: The student leader alleged that money intended for the graves of those killed in the July uprising has been misappropriated by the interim government.
details: Ishrak Hossain, a prominent student leader, has alleged that the interim government has embezzled funds specifically allocated for the graves of the July martyrs.
He made these claims during a press conference, accusing the current administration of misappropriating money meant for honoring those who died during the July uprising.
The allegations raise serious questions about the transparency and accountability of the funds managed by the interim government.
This development comes amid ongoing discussions regarding the memorialization of the martyrs of the July movement.
The interim government has not yet provided an official response to these specific allegations of embezzlement.
caption:
Funds for the martyrs' graves have been embezzled, claims Ishrak Hossain.

Ishrak Hossain, a prominent student leader, has alleged that the interim government has embezzled funds specifically allocated for the graves of the July martyrs.

He made these claims during a press conference, accusing the current administration of misappropriating money meant for honoring those who died during the July uprising.

The allegations raise serious questions about the transparency and accountability of the funds managed by the interim government.

This development comes amid ongoing discussions regarding the memorialization of the martyrs of the July movement.

The interim government has not yet provided an official response to these specific allegations of embezzlement.
